description.value: Okanagan Estate Wine Cellars is a neighbourhood wine shop in Kitsilano, Vancouver, specialising exclusively in British Columbia wines sourced directly from Okanagan and Vancouver Island producers at winery prices. The shop operates independently of any hotel, restaurant, or pub commitments, and its knowledgeable staff offer personalised wine guidance, in-store flights, and regular free producer tastings. A second location operates on West 4th Avenue, making this a well-established local chain with deep roots in the BC wine scene.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: wave at 52m; stands at 75m; stands at 88m; stands at 90m; rack at 91m; stands at 91m; stands at 94m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a real, actively operating neighbourhood wine shop at 1811 West 1st Ave, Kitsilano, Vancouver, matching the OSM address and phone number exactly. The events page lists 2025 in-store tastings (Hester Creek June 20th, Quail's Gate June 27th), confirming current operation. No cyclist-specific amenities — bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, charging — are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all remain null; the shop's retail model (walk-in purchase and online order pick-up) supports Takeout as true.
concerns: Website lists a second location — Okanangan Wine Cellars at 3669 West 4th Ave, Vancouver, BC V6R 1P2 (phone 604-730-1341) — which does not appear to have a separate OSM record; may warrant a second listing.
Website copyright reads '© 2017 Barnet Logic Group', suggesting the site template is old, though 2025 event dates confirm active maintenance.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible retail wine shop with confirmed 2025 events and active online store. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking BC wines.

Takeout.detail: Retail wine shop; customers purchase bottles to take away. Online orders can also be picked up in-store at the 1811 West 1st Ave location with no minimum quantity or service charge
